name: Pastel Geometry
tagline: One rounded white card on powder blue, with five pastel pill tabs on the right edge and soft geometric shapes. Adapted from the Pastel Geometry preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: powder-blue background, one warm off-white rounded card with a soft shadow, five pastel pills (pink, mint, sage, lavender, violet) as section tabs and accents, deep slate ink for text

typography.style: one geometric sans throughout: extra-bold 800 headlines with tight negative tracking in sentence case, 700 for item titles and chips, 400/500 for body

best_for: Friendly, well-organised decks: new-starter onboarding, team handbooks, internal how-we-work updates, workshops, course modules and product walkthroughs. Strong for agendas, step-by-step lists, simple stats and who-to-ask tables.
avoid_for: Hard-edged sales pitches, crisis or serious financial news, and very dense reading documents. The pastel palette and rounded shapes read soft and casual.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
